description:
‘Up Too Early Volume 2’ is the perfect compilation for early morning listening, curated by multidisciplinary musician Somni. In keeping with the narrative set by Volume 1, this iteration features a new host of good friends - Harris Cole, Shrimpnose, Joe Nora, Powermitts, Omari Jazz, S.Maharba, Soosh, Meridian, Duren, and Surfer Dave.

"Up Too Early is a compilation of tunes that to me encapsulate those weird twilight hours of the morning, when you know most of the city is still sleeping but for whatever reason you are awake. I’m very proud to have put this compilation together, lots of good friends on here as well as people who have inspired me over the years." - Somni
